title: Inverse image of a representable etale sheaf
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For an object $V$ of $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] the fibre product $X\times_YV$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with its first projection is an object of $X_{\Et}$. Let $f_*:\mathrm{Sh}(X_{\Et})\to\mathrm{Sh}(Y_{\Et})$ be the direct image of sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], $(f_*\mathcal F)(V)=\mathcal F(X\times_YV)$, and let $f^{-1}:\mathrm{Sh}(Y_{\Et})\to\mathrm{Sh}(X_{\Et})$ be a left adjoint of $f_*$. For a $Y$-scheme $W$ write $h_W$ for the sheaf $U\mapsto\operatorname{Mor}_Y(U,W)$ on $Y_{\Et}$, and for an $X$-scheme $W'$ write $h_{W'}$ for the sheaf $U\mapsto\operatorname{Mor}_X(U,W')$ on $X_{\Et}$ (these presheaves are sheaves by [lem-weil-pbc-small-etale-representable-presheaf-sheaf]). Then for every object $V$ of $Y_{\Et}$ there is an isomorphism of sheaves $f^{-1}h_V\cong h_{X\times_YV}$ on $X_{\Et}$, natural in $V$ (for $Y$-morphisms $V\to V'$ in $Y_{\Et}$).

source.place: Lemma Tag 03Q1 (lemma-stalk-pullback), part (4), lines 4648-4723; see also Sites, Lemma Tag 04D3 (sites-lemma-pullback-representable-sheaf)

proof.text: The first projection $X\times_YV\to X$ is etale: it is the base change of the etale morphism $V\to Y$ along $f$, by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change]. Hence $X\times_YV$ is an object of $X_{\Et}$, and the assignment $V\mapsto X\times_YV$ is functorial in $Y$-morphisms by the universal property of fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product].

For every sheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on $X_{\Et}$, the assumed adjunction gives a natural bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{X_{\Et}}(f^{-1}h_V,\mathcal F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{Y_{\Et}}(h_V,f_*\mathcal F)$. The representable presheaf $h_V$ is a sheaf by [lem-weil-pbc-small-etale-representable-presheaf-sheaf], and $\mathrm{Sh}(T_{\Et})$ is a full subcategory of presheaves by [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Therefore the general Yoneda evaluation bijection [lem-galois-yoneda-hom-bijection] identifies the latter Hom-set with $(f_*\mathcal F)(V)$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03Q1 (lemma-stalk-pullback), proof of part (4), lines 4700-4714; Sites, Lemma Tag 04D3 (sites-lemma-pullback-representable-sheaf)

proof.text: By the definition of the direct image in the statement, $(f_*\mathcal F)(V)=\mathcal F(X\times_YV)$. Since $X\times_YV$ is an object of $X_{\Et}$, the representable presheaf $h_{X\times_YV}$ is a sheaf by [lem-weil-pbc-small-etale-representable-presheaf-sheaf]. The general Yoneda evaluation bijection [lem-galois-yoneda-hom-bijection] therefore identifies this set with $\operatorname{Hom}_{X_{\Et}}(h_{X\times_YV},\mathcal F)$, naturally in $\mathcal F$. Combining with Step 2 gives a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{X_{\Et}}(f^{-1}h_V,\mathcal F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{X_{\Et}}(h_{X\times_YV},\mathcal F)$ natural in $\mathcal F$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03Q1 (lemma-stalk-pullback), proof of part (4), lines 4704-4717

proof.text: Write $A_V=f^{-1}h_V$ and $B_V=h_{X\times_YV}$. The natural Hom-bijection of Step 3, $\Phi_{V,\mathcal F}:\operatorname{Hom}(A_V,\mathcal F)\to\operatorname{Hom}(B_V,\mathcal F)$, gives the unique isomorphism $\theta_V=\Phi_{V,A_V}(\mathrm{id}_{A_V}):B_V\to A_V$ by [lem-weil-pbc-coyoneda-iso-of-natural-hom-bijection]; its inverse is the claimed $A_V\cong B_V$. For a $Y$-morphism $g:V\to V'$, the fibre-product universal property [def-pc-fibre-product] gives $g_X:X\times_YV\to X\times_YV'$. For every sheaf $\mathcal F$ the two routes from $\operatorname{Hom}(A_{V'},\mathcal F)$ to $\operatorname{Hom}(B_V,\mathcal F)$ agree: adjunction is natural in $h_g$, Yoneda evaluation is natural in the representing object by [lem-galois-yoneda-hom-bijection], and the direct-image restriction along $g$ is $\mathcal F(g_X)$. Thus $f^{-1}h_g\circ\theta_V=\theta_{V'}\circ h_{g_X}$ by the uniqueness clause of [lem-weil-pbc-coyoneda-iso-of-natural-hom-bijection]. Inverting this equality proves naturality of $\theta_V^{-1}:A_V\to B_V$ in $V$.
